# Alibaba Cloud

> > Alibaba Cloud provides comprehensive cloud computing infrastructure, AI/ML platforms, and managed services enabling businesses to scale globally with secure, compliant solutions across 29 regions.

Alibaba Cloud is a leading cloud service provider offering integrated solutions for compute, databases, AI/ML, and messaging services. The platform serves enterprises and developers with global infrastructure spanning 94 availability zones, strong security certifications, and specialized solutions for China market expansion.

## Key Topics

- ECS (Elastic Compute Service)
- Model Studio (GenAI/Qwen)
- Managed Databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
- Short Message Service (SMS)
- China Gateway
- Global Regions & Availability Zones
- Security & Compliance (C5, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR)
- Trust Center
- Developer Resources
- Pricing Calculator
- Partner Network
- Marketplace
- Asia Accelerator
- ICP Support
- CDN Services

## Core Products & Services

- [Elastic Compute Service (ECS)](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/ecs): Elastic, secure virtual cloud servers for scalable computing workloads.
- [Database Services](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/databases): Managed database solutions supporting MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and more.
- [Model Studio](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/modelstudio): GenAI platform featuring Qwen models and advanced image generation capabilities.
- [Short Message Service](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/short-message-service): Global SMS service for OTP, notifications, and promotional messaging.

## Global Infrastructure & Expansion

- [Global Locations](https://www.alibabacloud.com/global-locations): Deploy across 94 availability zones in 29 regions worldwide, including Mainland China.
- [China Gateway](https://www.alibabacloud.com/china-gateway): Enable business success in China with ICP support, CDN, and localized infrastructure.

## Security, Compliance & Trust

- [Trust Center](https://www.alibabacloud.com/trust-center): Security and compliance hub featuring C5, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, and other certifications.
